# Exclusively Reserved

> Private cultural experiences in and around Osaka, Japan, operated by Time and Place Inc. Every program is private (one party at a time) with an English-speaking host. Prices are per person, tax included, minimum two guests. Reserve at least one month ahead.

## Experiences

- [Sumiyoshi Taisha: A Private Shinto Ceremony](https://exclusivelyreserved.com/experiences/sumiyoshi-taisha/): Formal worship in ceremonial kimono, with a sacred kagura dance performed for your party alone. 2 hours · 2 to 10 guests, from ¥55,000 per person.
- [Oyosami Shrine: The Shrine, Reserved for You Alone](https://exclusivelyreserved.com/experiences/oyosami-shrine/): One party a day. A formal Shinto ceremony with the priest, tea ceremony and calligraphy. 2.5 hours · 2 to 10 guests, from ¥82,500 per person.
- [Osaka Kappo: A Michelin-Starred Counter, Explained](https://exclusivelyreserved.com/experiences/osaka-kappo/): The chef's course at a Michelin-starred counter, explained dish by dish by an Osaka food writer. About 3 hours, ¥70,000.
- [Deep Osaka: Izakaya Hopping and a Showa-Era Snack Bar](https://exclusivelyreserved.com/experiences/osaka-izakaya-night/): The Osaka night that only regulars know, with a local food expert as your guide. About 3 hours, ¥50,000.

## Prices (per person, tax included)

- Sumiyoshi Taisha: JPY 55,000 (2 hours); JPY 66,000 (3 hours, with kaiseki lunch)
- Oyosami Shrine in 2026: JPY 82,500 (2.5 hours); JPY 93,500 (3.5 hours, with kaiseki lunch); taxi transfer included
- Oyosami Shrine from January 2027: JPY 74,800 (2.5 hours); JPY 82,500 (3.5 hours, with kaiseki lunch); transfers not included
- Osaka kappo: JPY 70,000, drink pairing included
- Izakaya hopping and Showa-era snack bar: JPY 50,000, food and drinks included

## Booking and cancellation

- Reserve at least one month before the date. Later requests are accepted at the same price when a date is available.
- Free cancellation and free date change up to one month before. After that, cancellations are charged at 100%.
- Changes in the number of guests: contact us.
- If we or the shrine must cancel, a full refund or a new date is offered.
